coverage_rule: These rows exhaust the V0.1 operative architecture norms in P2-016 sections 3-5 and the technical-architecture row in FREEZE_STATUS. Each row has exactly one classification.

rows.v0_norm: V1 is single-device and local-first; the Must loop does not depend on sync, cloud, a real model, or formal Obsidian enablement.
rows.forward_rule: Local-first remains the default; sync and server are future boundaries, not MVP prerequisites.

rows.v0_norm: User originals, versions, Source/Artifact, confirmed meaning, Authorization, tombstones/restrictions and minimum audit are authoritative local facts/control records; AI/index/cache do not overwrite them.
rows.forward_rule: V1 keeps Source/Artifact separation, domain independence, SQLite authority and rebuildable derivations; P0-003/P0-009 safeguards remain binding.

rows.v0_norm: SQLite plus FTS-first is the local search path; FTS, chunks, summaries, candidates, cache and vectors are disposable/rebuildable derivations and vectors are deferred.
rows.forward_rule: FTS-first and rebuildability remain fixed; vector implementation is explicitly not frozen.

rows.v0_norm: Authority, derivation and outbox/job duties are distinct; an outbox is non-authoritative, jobs need idempotency/lease-fencing/retry/dead-letter, and dead-letter never releases an active safety block.
rows.v1_anchor: V1 §4 Background Jobs and Internal Events
rows.forward_rule: V1 retains local job table, worker and persistent-outbox direction. Exact queue mechanics remain implementation detail but cannot weaken the V0.1 responsibility/safety invariant.

rows.v0_norm: Before publish, display, index, re-derive, export, restore or externalize, recheck authorization/policy, source/license, exact version, tombstone/restriction generation, evidence, purpose/location/processor and lease; unknown mismatches fail closed.
rows.v1_anchor: V1 §2, §5 Search Port, §5 Source Port, §5 Model/Agent Ports, §9
rows.forward_rule: V1 places Authorization on important consumption/execution paths; all V0.1 recheck and fail-closed semantics remain required, not optional UI behavior.

rows.v0_norm: Durable save is not search readiness; long FTS maintenance must not block authoritative capture, and a search hit must reconnect to current authority before use.
rows.forward_rule: V1's authoritative/local-data and derived-search separation preserves this behavior; FTS implementation details stay unfrozen.

rows.v0_norm: Revocation/deletion blocks active use first and performs physical cleanup asynchronously; index/cleanup/export/restore states must be disclosed honestly.
rows.forward_rule: V1 keeps rebuildable derivatives and Authorization on consumption paths; P0-009 tombstone/no-revival semantics remain binding.

rows.v0_norm: Obsidian is default-off, user-selected-root, read-only, source-identified and reconcilable; source loss cannot revive data, and hand import/source pointer is the fallback.
rows.v1_anchor: V1 §5 Source Port and §7 Adapter Principles
rows.forward_rule: An Obsidian adapter remains optional; V1 does not grant write-back, sync, or broader authorization.

rows.v0_norm: Tauri/IPC freezes only a backend safety contract and re-test triggers: renderer has no generic OS capability; IPC is allowlisted/default-deny with path/scope checks, zero Vault write, isolated confirmed export, content identity and minimal audit.
rows.forward_rule: V1 retains Rust/Tauri as host security boundary. Exact capability/IPC configuration remains unfrozen; any trigger still requires re-validation and disabled capability until proved.

rows.v0_norm: Basic export, database-aware backup, safe recovery and derivative rebuild are responsibility contracts; models and suppliers must remain replaceable.
rows.v1_anchor: V1 §3 Core Capabilities, §4 Local Data, §5 Model Port, §7
rows.forward_rule: V1 includes Export/Recovery, rebuildable derivation, ModelPort and adapters; formats, suppliers and SLA are not frozen.

rows.v0_norm: Schema, APIs, domain-to-table mapping, IPC signatures/capabilities, FTS tables/PRAGMA/workers, sync/server stack, real cloud/model, formal Obsidian enablement, export format and production SLA are not frozen.
rows.forward_rule: V1 repeats this exclusion list; no promotion may imply any of these details are frozen.

rows.v0_norm: R-0040 is Open/Conditional: actual Tauri, capability/plugin/IPC/path-scope, file/Vault/export, packaging, WebView/CSP, sidecar or platform changes trigger re-test; unproven related capability stays closed.
rows.forward_rule: V1 does not close R-0040 or promote actual desktop capability evidence; later implementation must separately inherit the trigger/deny behavior.

rows.v0_norm: The contract must not become a Stage 3/MVP admission, real-data/real-cloud authorization, or production-capability claim.
rows.forward_rule: V1.0 architecture authority is not a Stage 4, risk-closure, Runtime, or real-capability promotion.

rows.v0_norm: V0.1 expressed responsibility contracts without freezing a full target code organization or desktop/UI implementation direction.
rows.forward_rule: V1.0 newly fixes the target modular-monolith/hexagonal layering, TypeScript Core, Tauri 2 desktop direction and initial Port families. It does not freeze individual implementations.

rows.v0_norm: Specific future server, cloud, queue, vector and workflow products were not architecture commitments.
rows.forward_rule: V1 names only optional adapter candidates; Fastify, PostgreSQL, Redis, Temporal, vector DB, cloud/sync protocol and device stacks remain future choices.

rows.v0_norm: V0.1 remains an immutable historical freeze record with its Review and Evidence; a successor must not rewrite or delete it.
rows.source: FREEZE_STATUS technical-architecture row; P3-129 ABF I-02
rows.forward_rule: Only forward technical-architecture authority transfers to V1.0 after final Gate; V0.1 historical facts, acceptance limits and Evidence remain preserved and auditable.
